description: A coin's USD price, market cap and 24h volume per day (up to 365 days back) or per hour (up to 90 days back), oldest first, by CoinGecko id (bitcoin, ethereum, usd-coin). Each point is the last sample in its day or hour, at the bucket's start. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

days.description: How many days back, 1 to 365 (1 to 90 for interval hour).
